evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never states 'Great, it looks like we have availability within your time frame. This will take about 10 to 15 minutes, and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on.' Instead jumps directly into logistics: 'So October 3rd yeah, we have availability.'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep immediately begins probing logistics: 'What time of day do you think it would be?' without first asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no explicit concerns raised by customer that required follow-up depth. Customer raises logistical questions and constraints (travel time, multi-day preference, truck loading) but these emerge organically as part of discovery, not as a separate agenda-setting section.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no formal concerns were raised in a dedicated agenda section; customer's constraints came out during probing and rep acknowledged them with 'Got it,' 'Mm-hmm,' and 'Okay' but never reflected back a summary like 'So what I'm hearing is...'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Partial. Gathered: pickup location (mom's house), storage location, item list (round table, coffee table, love seat, mattress), and multi-stop route. Missing: property type, floor/stories, number of rooms, walking distance to items, special considerations beyond what was mentioned. No formal room count or property classification.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: False — no mention of 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: False — no mention of typical box count or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial. Rep gives specific hourly rate ($206 for two guys on peak day) and final total ($655 for 2.5 hours including $140 trip fee), but does not anchor to a 'typical range for a home your size' — instead quotes directly on this small, sparse move without comparison framing.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Partial. Rep discloses trip fee ($140) and states 'everything's included: wrap, pad, disassemble, reassembly' and 'no extra charges, no credit card fees whatsoever.' Missing: explicit 2.5-hour-minimum commitment framing and 15-minute-increments language. No 'this is not a guess' framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep states 'I'll send the pricing and your quote to your email' and moves to booking without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or waiting for customer reaction to the $655 price.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: None — On-Time Guarantee never mentioned at all.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: None — No Worries Damage Coverage never mentioned at all.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False — Section 5 (Two Promises) is entirely absent. No closing statement or 'Does that put those to rest?'
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked — Rep does not ask 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or equivalent. Ends with 'any changes that you have just let us know' after booking is done.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False — No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' question.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' Instead, rep says 'Do you want to go ahead and lock in that date for now. We have it reserved for you' — booking is framed as optional hold, customer then initiates: 'let's go ahead and book it.' Rep does not close with an explicit sales ask.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: False — No mention of rate lock or deposit policy until customer asks 'What do you need for that credit card number or something?' and rep responds 'Nope, we don't require a deposit to book.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (Saturday October 3rd), arrival window (8:30–9 a.m.), phone callback on the way. Missing: explicit confirmation of phone number in final booking (customer's phone was verified earlier: 'is this the best phone number ending in 8455'), no crew size confirmed, addresses were discussed but not re-confirmed at booking, no crew notes about customer's concerns (e.g., multiple stops, storage rearrangement plan).

top_strength: Rep successfully navigated a complex multi-stop move (pickup from mom's house → storage with rearrangement → hold for future move) and clarified the logistics without losing the customer, ultimately booking the appointment despite the move being outside the normal service area.
coaching_note: Section 1 has no quid pro quo framing — rep must establish 'this will take 10–15 minutes, you'll walk away with a quote you can depend on' before diving into logistics; Sections 2 and 5 (Their Agenda and Two Promises) are entirely missing; and Section 7 never includes an explicit 'Would you like our help with your move?' ask — rep needs to lead with that closing, not let the customer volunteer to book.
